summary: Iter20 backend testing for simplified Seller Self-Deliver refactor. All 14 tests passed (100%). Verified empty-body one-click completion for both restaurant-orders and marketplace splits (delivered + collected_by_seller + not_applicable cash handover), admin-managed rejection (400), invalid-status rejection (400), deprecated /self-deliver-start no-op wrapper (200 without state change), reverted /api/driver/location (seller now 403, driver 200, customer 403), plus regressions for seller COD contact redaction (iter17) and seller_earning_usd delivery inclusion (iter19), and /api/health.
critical_code_review_comments: cod.py: `rest_self_deliver_complete` and `seller_self_deliver_complete` correctly accept no body param — Pydantic 422 concern from the spec is a non-issue since FastAPI treats {} as valid when no body model is declared.

server.py POST /api/driver/location correctly reverted to require_role('driver') — kitchen dashboard should no longer mount DriverGeoBeacon for seller-managed entities (verified only at code level, not UI).
cod.py file is ~1500+ lines — consider splitting seller/admin/driver routers into separate modules for maintainability (informational).
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped fixture creates TEST_-prefixed seller/driver/customer users, 2 shops (seller & admin managed), 2 restaurants (seller & admin managed), 4 splits, 4 restaurant_orders. All cleaned up on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter20 refactor: /self-deliver-complete endpoints (both splits + restaurant-orders) take EMPTY JSON body {}. No OTP/signature/receiver_name. Seller-managed only. Deprecated /self-deliver-start still returns 200 as no-op. /api/driver/location is driver-only (seller 403). Kitchen customer receipt is pure frontend (window.open + print) — not tested here.
